q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT EMAIL, COUNT(EMAIL) AS COUNT_EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM CTE1 WHERE COUNT_EMAIL > 1

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 groups by EMAIL and then filters for COUNT(EMAIL) > 1, which can lead to incorrect results if the EMAIL column contains NULL values. Q2, on the other hand, uses a CTE to first count the occurrences of each EMAIL and then filters for COUNT_EMAIL > 1, which correctly handles NULL values by excluding them from the count.
counterexample_dsp: The test data should include at least one NULL value in the EMAIL column to trigger the difference between Q1 and Q2.
